title: Road Hazard Protection Credit on Alignment Services & Plans Household Plans
content:
**Protection credit.** A protection credit is taken off the price of an Alignment Services & Plans household plan, computed by the Road Hazard Protection the customer holds:

1. when the customer holds an active Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection or Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate, the credit is 5.00 for each tire that certificate covers, the Plus 36-Month certificate's tires counting when the customer holds both kinds;
2. when the customer holds only another active road hazard certificate, the credit is a flat 10.00;
3. when the customer holds no active road hazard certificate, no protection credit is given.

The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the household price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

| Customer's active Road Hazard Protection certificates (hypothetical) | Credit |
|---|---|
| Plus 36-Month certificate covering 4 tires | 4 tires at 5.00: 20.00 |
| Life-of-Tread certificate covering 2 tires | 2 tires at 5.00: 10.00 |
| Plus 36-Month covering 2 tires and Life-of-Tread covering 4 tires | the Plus 36-Month certificate's 2 tires: 10.00 |
| Only a 24-Month certificate | flat 10.00 |
| None active | none |
